error_page_body: The page couldn't be rendered. Retry, head home, or share the details below with support.
not_found_body: The page you're looking for may have moved, been removed, or never existed. Check the address or head back to a familiar place.
overview_body: Workspace-level overview for this organization. Analytics, activity, and quick actions will land here.
agents_page_subtitle: Pick an agent to manage its knowledge base, web sources, and skills.
agents_page_empty: No agents registered for this tenant.
try_out_title: Open this agent + version in the widget playground
versions_body: Every version defined for this agent in the catalog. Exactly one is enabled ("live") at a time. Branch the live version to create a draft you can safely edit.
versions_branch_dialog_body: Copies the live version's config, KB documents, web sources, and skills into a new version. The new version is created as a draft.
versions_branch_to_hint: Letters, numbers, dot, underscore, dash. Up to 32 chars.
versions_branch_enable_hint: Not recommended — leave off to preview safely, then enable when ready.
versions_branch_in_progress: Branching to {toVersion}… this may take a few seconds.
versions_branch_leave_confirm: Branching is still in progress. Leaving now may interrupt the process. Leave anyway?
versions_set_live_body: Currently live: {currentVersion}. New chats that use "?version=live" will immediately start running {toVersion}. Threads pinned to a specific version (e.g. {currentVersion}) will keep running that version.
tools_body: Every built-in tool declared in the registry catalog. Toggle to enable or disable it for this agent version.
tools_empty: No tools declared for this agent version.
tools_catalog_empty: No built-in tools declared at the top level of the registry.
tools_unknown_hint: Referenced by this agent but not declared in the top-level catalog. Toggle off to remove.
general_body: The human-readable summary of what this agent version does. Shown wherever the agent is listed.
general_card_body: Save writes back to the registry YAML on S3. Validation runs server-side before the file is replaced.
general_description_placeholder: Specialist weather assistant — forecasts, current conditions, temperature conversions
prompt_body: The instructions injected as the system message on every turn for this agent version.
prompt_card_body: Save writes back to the registry YAML on S3. Validation runs server-side before the file is replaced.
prompt_placeholder: You are a helpful assistant that…
model_body: Which LLM this agent version calls. Credentials stay under tenant.vars and can't be edited here.
model_card_body: Save rewrites the model block for this version.
model_api_key_hint: Literal, or a tenant var reference like the placeholder above.
model_base_url_hint: Point at any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (e.g. Bifrost, DeepSeek, OpenRouter). Leave blank for api.openai.com.
model_credentials_note: API keys and Bedrock credentials are referenced via tenant vars in the registry and can't be edited here.
kb_root_body: Documents indexed into the vector store, and web sources ingested straight into the KB.
kb_upload_body: PDF, DOCX, TXT, HTML, or Markdown. File and sidecar are presigned to S3; Bedrock ingestion is triggered after upload.
kb_upload_leave_confirm: Upload and indexing are still in progress. Leaving now may interrupt the process. Leave anyway?
kb_web_leave_confirm: Web ingestion is still in progress. Leaving now may interrupt the process. Leave anyway?
kb_delete_leave_confirm: A delete is still re-syncing with Bedrock. Leaving now may interrupt the process. Leave anyway?
kb_docs_delete_body: The file will be removed from S3 and Bedrock will re-index the knowledge base to prune its vectors. This cannot be undone.
kb_web_delete_body: The page will be removed from the knowledge base immediately. This cannot be undone.
kb_web_refresh_body: Re-fetches the page from its URL and re-indexes the knowledge base. Any changes since last fetch will replace the current content.
kb_docs_body: Files under the KB prefix in S3 for this scope. Ingestion status lives in Bedrock; refresh to re-check.
kb_docs_empty: No documents uploaded for this version.
kb_web_seed_body: Ingest a single page — or toggle "follow sitemap" to crawl every URL the site lists (up to 100, throttled to 1 request/sec).
kb_web_seed_summary_single_fallback: Indexed 1 page (no sitemap found; ingested as single URL).
kb_web_list_body: Documents currently in the web data source. Statuses come from Bedrock.
skills_upload_body: Zip archive or a single SKILL.md file.
skills_upload_leave_confirm: Upload in progress. Leave the page?
skills_list_body: Skills the agent can invoke via the tools bus.
skill_delete_confirm_body: This removes the skill and all its resource files from S3.
skills_editor_body: Editing SKILL.md only. Resource files (references) are not editable here.
skills_editor_refresh_note: Changes propagate to the running agent within about 2 minutes.
debug_drawer_body: Inline editor for the S3-hosted catalog. Save writes through the middleware (PUT /agents/catalog).
